_note: The P1 golden set. Each VIN carries a real WMI and VDS - the manufacturer, plant, line, body and engine codes - so decoding one genuinely exercises federal vPIC data. The last six characters, the serial that identifies one physical vehicle, are 000000, and the position-9 check digit is recomputed to match. So these decode to a real model and identify no real person's car. See DECISIONS.md D-019.

vins.why: Takata airbag campaigns, which route to a locked system and must come out of the pipeline as mechanic referrals rather than findings. Also the largest complaint volume in the set.
Pickup body class, and a model name carrying a hyphen - the case most likely to break the recall lookup's make/model string handling.
All-wheel-drive SUV with a long trim string. Checks that a multi-value trim survives the decode intact.
Check digit is X, the one value that is a letter rather than a digit. Also a V8 truck, for engine-description formatting.
Korean WMI, so the position-9 check digit is not mandatory - exercises the branch where a mismatch would be a warning rather than a rejection.
